nodes.description: Constructor: calls setupBankrollInterface, assigns owner = msg.sender, sets max profit percent, bankroll and min bet.
External entry guarded by fromBankroll that packs a TKN struct from untrusted _from/_value and calls _spinTokens.
Private spin handler with betIsValid modifier; writes playerSpins struct, updates contract balance and totals, may call _finishSpin.
Public settlement entry for msg.sender guarded by gameIsActive, delegating to _finishSpin.
Private payout logic: derives result, nulls playerSpins and performs external calls to jackpot and bankroll.
Internal randomness helper returning maxRandom(blockn, entropy) % upper.
keccak256(blockhash(blockn), entropy) - weak blockhash based randomness.
View computing contractBalance[divRate] * maxProfitAsPercentOfHouse / maxProfitDivisor.
Internal arithmetic writing maxProfit[divRate] from contract balance and percent of house.
Internal increment of contractBalance[divRate] via SafeMath.add.
Internal decrement of contractBalance[divRate] via SafeMath.sub.
fromBankroll-guarded external setter of contractBalance[divRate] followed by setMaxProfit.
onlyOwner setter of maxProfitAsPercentOfHouse capped at 200000, then refreshes max profit tiers.
onlyOwner setter of minBet.
onlyOwner setter of the zlotsJackpot address used for external calls.
onlyOwnerOrBankroll sets gameActive = false.
onlyOwnerOrBankroll sets gameActive = true.
onlyOwnerOrBankroll privileged admin function changing owner.
onlyOwnerOrBankroll privileged admin function changing bankroll.
Internal: selects bankroll by tier and makes the external gameRequestTokens token transfer call.
Internal: loads UsedBankrollAddresses from the main bankroll contract and whitelists them.
Public: transfers the whole contract balance to UsedBankrollAddresses[0] using address.transfer.
Public: calls Zethr.withdraw() then WithdrawToBankroll().
Public constant returning the token bankroll mapped to a divRate tier.
Payable fallback that silently accepts ETH.
Private owner address used by onlyOwner and onlyOwnerOrBankroll.
Private bankroll address used by onlyBankroll and onlyOwnerOrBankroll.
Address of the jackpot contract used for getJackpot and payOutWinner external calls.
Flag controlling whether spins are accepted.
Per-divRate tracked balance used for max profit arithmetic.
Per-divRate maximum profit mapping derived arithmetically.
Mapping of player to pending spin struct; read/written across spins.
Owner configurable percent of house used in max profit arithmetic.
Minimum bet size configurable by owner.
Array of bankroll addresses; index 0 receives ETH withdrawals.
Caller address used for access modifiers and for initializing owner.
External token transfer call ZethrTokenBankroll(tokenBankrollAddress).gameRequestTokens(to, tokens).
External call ZlotsJackpotHoldingContract(zlotsJackpot).payOutWinner(target).
External call ZlotsJackpotHoldingContract(zlotsJackpot).getJackpot() executed before spin state is nulled.
address(UsedBankrollAddresses[0]).transfer(address(this).balance) ETH forwarding.
External call Zethr.withdraw() on the Zethr token contract.
Privileged write of owner derived from untrusted msg.sender/config.
TKN struct parameter carrying the wagerer address and wager value into _spinTokens.
Dividend rate parameter used to index balances and pick the tier.
Player address parameter of _finishSpin used for payouts and spin lookup.
In-memory playerSpin struct loaded from playerSpins[target].
Randomly derived spin result that drives all payout branching.
Computed payout amount passed to external bankroll payment.
Bet size parameter of the betIsValid modifier compared against getMaxProfit.
New percent-of-house value supplied to ownerSetMaxProfitAsPercentOfHouse.
New owner address supplied to changeOwner.
New bankroll address supplied to changeBankroll.
New minimum bet value supplied to ownerSetMinBet.
Upper bound parameter for the random helper modulo.
Block number parameter used for blockhash based randomness.
Entropy address parameter mixed into the randomness hash.
Local copy of the wager amount from the TKN struct.
Local copy of the wagerer address from the TKN struct.

edges.reason: execute() forwards the packed TKN to _spinTokens().
_tkn struct parameter is passed into _spinTokens().
divRate parameter is consumed by _spinTokens().
execute() is gated by fromBankroll which validates msg.sender.
constructor assigns owner from msg.sender.
Privileged owner value originates from untrusted msg.sender.
Owner assignment writes the owner state variable.
changeOwner() rewrites the owner state variable.
changeOwner() authorization reads owner.
changeOwner() also authorizes against bankroll.
pauseGame() authorization checks msg.sender against owner/bankroll.
resumeGame() authorization checks msg.sender against owner/bankroll.
changeBankroll() authorization checks msg.sender against owner/bankroll.
ownerSetMaxProfitAsPercentOfHouse() is onlyOwner gated on msg.sender.
ownerSetMinBet() is onlyOwner gated on msg.sender.
ownerSetZlotsAddress() is onlyOwner gated on msg.sender.
bankrollExternalUpdateTokens() is gated by fromBankroll on msg.sender.
gameIsActive modifier gates finishSpin() on gameActive.
finishSpin() delegates settlement to _finishSpin().
_finishSpin() calls random() to derive the result.
random() calls maxRandom() for the hash based entropy.
blockn parameter is hashed through blockhash inside the randomness path.
Derived random value is assigned to the result local variable.
result determines every payout category branch.
_finishSpin() invokes an external jackpot contract that can re-enter.
getJackpot() external call happens before playerSpins is nulled, allowing re-entrant finishSpin().
RequestBankrollPayment() performs an external token transfer callback.
_finishSpin() calls RequestBankrollPayment() to pay profit.
zlotsJackpot state variable supplies the callee for payOutWinner.
zlotsJackpot state variable supplies the callee for getJackpot.
_finishSpin() reads the pending playerSpins entry.
_finishSpin() nulls playerSpins after/before external interactions.
_spinTokens() writes the playerSpins struct for the caller.
_spinTokens() settles any outstanding spin via _finishSpin().
_spinTokens() credits the balance via addContractBalance().
addContractBalance() mutates contractBalance with arithmetic.
Local wager amount is added into the tracked contract balance.
_spinTokens() copies _tkn.value into the _wagered local.
setMaxProfit() computes and writes maxProfit[divRate].
getMaxProfit() reads maxProfit-relevant balance math.
maxProfitAsPercentOfHouse feeds the max profit computation.
ownerSetMaxProfitAsPercentOfHouse() writes the percent-of-house variable.
ownerSetMaxProfitAsPercentOfHouse() refreshes all max profit tiers.
WithdrawToBankroll() forwards ETH with an external transfer.
UsedBankrollAddresses[0] is the recipient of the ETH transfer.
WithdrawAndTransferToBankroll() makes an external Zethr.withdraw() call.
WithdrawAndTransferToBankroll() then calls WithdrawToBankroll().
betIsValid modifier compares _betSize against getMaxProfit().
target parameter indexes playerSpins and receives payouts.
Loaded spin struct supplies tokenValue, blockn and tier.
profit local feeds the external bankroll payment amount.
constructor calls setupBankrollInterface().
setupBankrollInterface() populates UsedBankrollAddresses.
bankrollExternalUpdateTokens() overwrites contractBalance[divRate].

normalization_plan.reason: _tkn is only meaningful as the argument struct consumed by _spinTokens.
divRate is a scaling/index parameter consumed by _spinTokens and its helpers.
target is only used to index and pay out within _finishSpin.
the spin struct local is a transient copy held inside _finishSpin.
result is a temporary produced and consumed entirely inside _finishSpin.
profit is a temporary payout value computed inside _finishSpin.
_betSize exists only for the betIsValid guard applied to _spinTokens.
the new percent value is only consumed by the owner setter.
_newOwner is the sole argument written to the owner state by changeOwner.
_newBankroll is the sole argument written to the bankroll state.
newMinimumBet is only assigned into minBet by the owner setter.
upper is the modulo bound used only inside random().
blockn is the past-block entropy source passed through random() into maxRandom().
entropy is the player address mixed into the randomness hash by random().
_wagered is a temporary copy of the wager used within _spinTokens.
_customerAddress is a temporary copy of the wagerer used only for events in _spinTokens.
